answer: A newcomer locks a refundable 260 POA bond for 90 days before paid work, so one fake identity costs 260 POA plus three months no farm can run in parallel. It must first pass a lagoon check, one live task with no warning, due in twenty minutes. Its first ten jobs sit on a public copper record buyers read first, and three auditors by lot replay one job a month. Each verified job earns a plume mark only the paying client can stamp, and a forged mark burns the bond and bars the key for a year.
